info.name: Redfin Data Center CSV Export Market Tracker API

items.docs: Downloads the national-level housing market tracker dataset in compressed TSV format. Contains aggregate housing metrics across the entire United States including median sale price, homes sold, new listings, days on market, inventory, and price drops.
Downloads the metro-level housing market tracker dataset in compressed TSV format. Contains housing metrics segmented by metropolitan statistical areas across the United States.
Downloads the state-level housing market tracker dataset in compressed TSV format. Contains housing metrics aggregated at the state level for all US states and territories.
Downloads the county-level housing market tracker dataset in compressed TSV format. Contains housing metrics segmented by county across the United States.
Downloads the city-level housing market tracker dataset in compressed TSV format. Contains housing metrics segmented by city across the United States.

info.name: Download ZIP code-level market tracker data

items.docs: Downloads the ZIP code-level housing market tracker dataset in compressed TSV format. Contains housing metrics segmented by ZIP code across the United States. This is the most granular widely available dataset.
Downloads the neighborhood-level housing market tracker dataset in compressed TSV format. Contains housing metrics segmented by Redfin-defined neighborhood boundaries.
